title: God the Father Be Our Stay
alsoKnownAs: God the Father with Us Stay
God the Father with Us Be
description: God the Father Be Our Stay in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Martin Luther, first published in 1500. The English translation is by Richard Massie (1854). The tune, GOTT DER VATER, WOHN UNS BEI, is from Walter's Geistliche Gesangbüchlein, 1524. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.

Keep us from the E-vil One; Firm in the faith a-bid_-ing, In Christ our Sa-vior hid__-ing, And heart-i-ly con-fid_-ing. lines: God the Father, be our Stay,
When hell's dread pow'rs assail us;

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Cleanse us from our sins, we pray,
Nor in our last hour fail us.
Keep us from the Evil One;
Let us put God's armor on:
